agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has sensor_noise ~0.015 on pole-angle measurement with no pushes. Controller acts on corrupted angle feedback, applying incorrect forces (e.g., ~36.8N at step 35, ~42.9N at step 40) that pump energy (1.46 initial to 8.2 at step 35 to 24.4 at step 40 to 37.6 at step 43) instead of stabilizing. Pole swings from near-upright to 0.86 rad by step 43, violating pole_upright. Removing noise alone prevents failure, confirming noisy feedback as cause.
